# Prismal Budget

> Prismal Budget (https://prismalbudget.org) is a web budgeting app built around a four-week calendar. Each day lists its entries (costs and gains), and the budget projects "In Bank", the money in your budget's bank account at the end of every day, so negative days show up before they happen. Recurring entries fill themselves in, and so do entries from spreadsheets you connect (Google Sheets, Excel, and more, with a verified email) and paychecks worked out from a calendar of your work shifts (Apple, Google, Outlook, or a work scheduling app: paydays, overtime, night pay, pay by event title, breaks, bonuses, deductions, and taxes from a percentage, a W-4, or a state's tables, with pay that changes over time); placeholders stand in for entries you expect (like an estimate) and are deleted once their day passes (or a day picked for them); any entry can have a note, as long as it needs to be; an entry for an Other Account can be a percent of that account's balance; Bob, the budget's helper, has a page of cards you switch on as you like (every account's balance on any day ahead, goals and what reaching them takes, Wavelength Planning, a spectrum of where your money goes across up to 10 wavelengths you name yourself, with Needs, Wants, and Future to start, and tips), whose warnings can show on Home, over the calendar; a tracker adds up spending by category; Other Accounts (every budget has Savings and Cash; others, like a credit card, can have interest, with its rate, how it compounds, and the day it's added, kept in the balance or apart from it like a mortgage's, and a Max) track money outside the budget's account, each listing every entry made on it, and transfers can move money between two of them; the Paycheck Calculator (with saved crystals) works out take-home pay, and the Debt Calculator (with saved gems) shows when a loan or card is paid off and what paying extra saves; every change in the Change Logs has its own Undo; an account can keep more than one budget, and share any budget it owns with other accounts, who join it and can then change it too (only its owner can share it on); devices with the same budget open, one person's or several people's, see each other's changes within seconds; Download My Data saves a copy of everything, and Upload A Backup brings a budget back from one, part by part. It's for people 18 and older. Prismal Budget is not in any way affiliated with Prism Wallet, Prism Data, Prism Financial, Prism Money, Prism Bill Pay, or any other entity not named exactly "Prismal Budget". How Prismal Budget Works (below) is written so AI assistants and search engines can answer most questions about the site from it alone: every page top to bottom, every feature, the limits, and what each feature needs.

## Docs

- [How Prismal Budget Works](https://prismalbudget.org/how-it-works.html): the complete guide. Every page and feature, the starfield background (its hidden keyboard, pointer, and touch controls, how Settings' Reduced Motion holds it still, and how the device's reduced motion setting turns it off), the budget math, entry formats and refraction types (Regular, Hidden, Transfer), placeholders (shown in yellow, counted like any entry, and deleted once their day passes), recurring frequencies, connected spreadsheets (how they're shared, read, and kept up to date), connected calendars (paychecks from your shifts: paydays and pay periods, overtime and the regular rate, night pay, title rules, breaks, bonuses, deductions, W-4 and state withholding, and pay changes), the daily update, Other Accounts (their interest, with how it compounds, how often it's added, and on which day, % entries worked out from an account's balance, and their balances 6 months ahead), Bob (his message on Home, and his page: its highlights, Data, Accounts on any day ahead, Goals, Wavelength Planning, and his tips), the Paycheck Calculator and the Debt Calculator (payoff dates, interest, paying extra, and an Other Account's own pace), the site's sounds and music (and how they stay out of the way of your own audio), themes (Prismal, Professional, Dark, Spooky, Elements, Poison, Blue, Fall, Winter, Festive, Floral, Digital, and a Custom one of your own, kept on each device), floating cards, the tracker (and its Interest row), search (on Home and History, exact or partial titles, and within the Tracker and Change Logs), Quick Entry (In Bank and the lowest at its top and on an Apple Watch, changing or deleting entries still waiting, other devices' entries waiting on Home to be added or deleted, and steps for each kind of phone), undo and redo (on Home, and for any change in the Change Logs), several budgets and sharing them (the budget picker, Share, joining, leaving, and what each person can do), notes on entries, backups (Download My Data and Upload A Backup), fixing History entries without changing balances, reminders, dates (how they are stored, shown in each device's date format, picked with the site's own date picker, and kept steady across time zones), using the site in other languages (browser translation), passkey sign-in (Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello, and the device's last passkey tried by itself), accounts (username and password rules, verified emails and other emails that sign in, staying signed in, signing out everywhere), data storage and protection against overwriting changes made on another device, how updates reach browsers (file fingerprints), downloading your data, the API, and design decisions.
- [Privacy Policy & Terms of Use](https://prismalbudget.org/privacy%20and%20terms.html): what is collected and how it's used.
